tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures support a coupled transient mechanism, but the five pilot rows leave genuine parameter-identifiability ambiguity. The trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to fit it.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter siphon-memory ODE to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations do not adequately identify and validate the coupled ODE parameters.
Neither captures the observed coupled transient lag and memory dependence.
It is irrelevant to identifying the proposed mechanism.
